d: Short, messy copper-brown hair with thick bangs and a small yellow warning-sign clip. Large, rounded amber eyes with a neutral expression, paired with a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build, wearing a black cropped tank top, a tactical utility belt with pouches, and brown cargo pants, all layered under a heavy mechanical neck brace and shoulder harness. Signature details include large black over-ear headphones and a series of blue chemical canisters attached to the waist.
